evidence.title: Axiom - The modern machine data platform
Pricing that scales with you, not against you - Axiom

name: Axiom
summary: Machine data platform that ingests, stores and queries logs, metrics, traces and events at petabyte scale.
description: Axiom ingests logs, metrics, traces and events at petabyte scale into a fully managed, schema-less event store. Query with APL for logs, events and traces and MPL for metrics; dashboards, monitors and a native MCP server let humans and AI agents run the same queries. Usage-based pricing with a free Personal tier and a $25/month Axiom Cloud platform fee.
contains: logs, events, traces and metrics in one fully managed event store; APL for logs/events/traces, MPL for metrics
native MCP server so AI agents query the same data as engineers
free Personal tier: 500 GB/mo data loading compute, 10 GB-hrs query compute, 25 GB storage, 30-day retention
Axiom Cloud from $25/month platform fee + usage, with automatic volume discounts
integrations: OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, AWS (CloudWatch, Lambda, S3), Vercel and SDKs in 8 languages
dashboards and monitors share one query surface with alerts
enterprise add-ons in-console: RBAC $50/month, SSO, directory sync, extended audit logs
